notes.title: The Indie game "Red & Black" is now on sale!
notes.content:
The game is now on sale! Everyone is welcome to come and play. 

"Red and Black" has a unique gravity control gameplay, six game mechanisms, and more than one hundred levels. 

Our game can not appear in front of everyone without the support of all players. 

Thanks to all the friends who helped us along the way. I hope "Red and Black" can make everyone enjoy themselves.
